scope: To identify candidate mediators of nuclear actin polymerization upon mechanical force, we performed mass spectrometry of endogenous RASSF1A immunoprecipitates from control versus sorbitol-exposed HeLa cells.

Total protein lysate (10 mg) was incubated for 3 hours with protein A Dynabeads (Invitrogen) and 10 μg of RASSF1A antibody (Atlas, #HPA040735) or rIgG at 4°C. After the immunoprecipitation, beads were subjected to two additional washes with water before performing an on-bead digest using Smart trypsin (Thermo Fisher).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry was performed on material affinity-purified via immunoprecipitation of endogenous RASSF1A from total protein lysates.
